title: Immersive Casting for Ars Nouveau
description: This mod allows you to cast Ars Nouveau spells in the most immersive manner: speech.
body:
# Immersive Casting For Ars Nouveau
This Mod is an Addon for Ars Nouveau. Using this mod, you can cast spells just by speech.

## Features
### Speech Casting
- While Using a casting_wand, you can call names of glyphs(e.g. "projectile ignite extend time"), and it will be casted.
- You can do the same thing with custom spells and its names.
### Custom Spells
- Custom Spell's config file is in config/chabs_immersivecasting/custom_spells (an example file will be generated).
- By calling the spell's name (e.g. "example"), the defined spell will be casted(e.g. "projectile lightning).
### Survival-Friendly
- You can craft a casting wand in survival.
- Mana consumed as usual.

## Configureable Settings
Enable Glyph Casting: you'll be able to cast glyphs (e.g. "projectile harm amplify")
(if false, you can cast custom spells only.)

## Notes
This mod is still in development and experiment. Things are not completed.
Some Glyphs are not able to cast(slowfall, wololo, etc.)
Other mod using VoiceLib might be affected.

### Requirements
- Ars Nouveau (and its requirements)
- Voice Lib
- Architectury
